text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked about Tanino Gimlet taking time 
off to recover, Symboli Kris S replied 
that it had no bearing on her. The public 
criticized her as being far too cold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet was the reason Symboli Kris 
S aimed for the Tenno Sho (Autumn), but 
she worries whether simply running can 
truly repay that debt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, prompted by her Trainer, Symboli 
Kris S recalled her conversation with 
Tanino Gimlet and realized that great 
things were expected of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Tanino Gimlet spoke. She 
had etched the memory of her run deep into 
people's minds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In contrast, Symboli Kris S spoke of her 
resolve: to display a strength so 
overwhelming it would overwrite those 
memories and ignite a revolution. That was 
her way of showing gratitude.
